methodology: Diagnoses in out\claude_api_run graded via gemini (gemini-3.5-flash) using JUDGE_PROMPT_TEMPLATE from harness/scoring/rca_judge.py, ported byte-for-byte into this standalone script, and scored with the identical _score_from_hits formula: overall = (0.6*causal_chain_coverage + 0.4*required_elements_coverage) * distractor_penalty. This is a cross-model grading pass -- the judge model is deliberately different from the model whose diagnoses are being graded, so no model grades its own answers.

s001.rationale: The agent accurately identified the root cause, models affected (M_0147, M_0148, M_0149 in Z_NW), MemoryError mechanism, and the lag in rolling-average VM sizing, while avoiding all distractors. It only missed step 6 of the causal chain regarding the next-day auto-resolution.
s001.note: s001's ground truth was rewritten 2026-09-14 (VM-capacity root cause replacing the original missing-training-config root cause). This entry is against the NEW ground truth; it is not comparable to any pre-2026-09-14 s001 number elsewhere in this repo's history.
